missing_row: row None -> append caller default verbatim (instance_value.py:45-46); default may itself be None (e.g. GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID default os.environ.get(...) -> None when unset).
resolver: get_configuration_value(keys) -> tuple in input order (instance_value.py:28-54). db_keys = keys whose _source(key) == 'db' (:29); single query filter(key__in=db_keys).values(key,value,is_encrypted) (:34-36); encrypted rows decrypted via decrypt_data (:47-48); plain rows verbatim (:50); env-sourced keys read os.environ.get(name, default) at call time (:52).
source_policy: _source(key) = CONFIG[key].source if registered else 'env' (instance_value.py:14-18). NOTE asymmetry with the serializer default: unregistered keys resolve to 'env' here but 'db' in InstanceConfigurationSerializer (configuration.py:26).

GITHUB_APP_NAME.note: read by instances endpoint from env only, never seeded

workflows.configure_instance_derived_flags: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET etc. resolved through this function with env fallbacks (configure_instance.py:65-76,90-100,114-128,142-156)
workflows.instance_get_15_keys: 15 keys resolved per call with inline defaults (views/instance.py:66-126); e.g. ENABLE_SIGNUP default os.environ.get('ENABLE_SIGNUP','0') (note: endpoint default '0' differs from seed default '1' in core.py)
